name: com.betahub.bugreporter
description: In-game bug reports and suggestions for BetaHub. The player describes what happened; the report carries a screenshot, the last 60 seconds of play as video with sound, and the game log. Works with keyboard, mouse and controllers.

samples.description: A tiny game with a broken coin. Press Play, find the bug, then press F12 (or Start on a controller) to report it to BetaHub's public demo project.
Scripts that add custom fields to reports and sign players in to BetaHub through their browser (device authentication).
